responsibility: Defines the full-width AVX-512 VBMI intrinsic API for byte-level vector permutation and multishift operations on 512-bit vectors. The header maps intrinsics such as _mm512_multishift_epi64_epi8, _mm512_permutexvar_epi8, and _mm512_permutex2var_epi8, including masked variants, onto the corresponding GCC builtins for the baseline 512-bit VBMI extension.
